name: Ibuki Haruna
source:
A first-year student and a member of the basketball team. Haruna is a roommate of [url=https://vndb.org/c590]Sakuma[/url] in the dormitory of Takizono Academy and has a calm personality. Her father is a manager of a company which imports and sells high-level foreign cars.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
